Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the second innings of Zimbabwe. Prince Masvaure and Kevin Kasuza will open the innings. Sayed Shirzad will begin with the ball for Afghanistan. Here we go..
Afghanistan now have enough time to bowl Zimbabwe out. The trail is another 258 and Zimbabwe need a miracle if they are to salvage something out of this game. Will we see one? We will find out...

Three out of the 4 bowlers were excellent for Afghanistan. Hamza, Rashid and Shirzad. Ahmadi did manage to keep it tight when he was asked to bowl but It was all about those three. Rashid bagged while Hamza got three and Shirzad managed two to his name.

The Zimbabwe batting just fell apart after that very good opening partnership. They kept losing wickets at regular intervals. They were reeling at 6 for 189 at one stage. Raza though along with the lower order showed some fight and took the Zimbabwe score close to 300. Still a long way behind Afghanistan’s score.
Right! The news is that Afghanistan have enforced the follow-on. A bit surprising, after having bowled for over 91 overs, one would've thought they might bat a few overs but they think otherwise.

OUT! TAKEN! Raza falls and it is the end of the Zimbabwe innings. He had to go for the big shots with the no. 11 at the other end. Rashid bowled a lovely loopy ball outside off, Raza danced down the track but failed to get to the pitch of the ball. Ended up miscuing it high in the air towards long off. Rahmat takes a fine catch near the ropes. End of Zimbabwe innings. They have been bowled out for 287.
Victor Nyauchi is the last man in.

RUN OUT! Muzarabani is short. He should've done a lot better there. He was at the non-striker's end and he had to go for the double. A low full toss, Raza drives it through extra cover. He wants two as he wants to keep the strike. Muzarabani is a bit slow in taking off. The fielder from the deep throws the ball to Rashid. The throw is a bit wayward but Rashid collects and hits the stumps from close range. The third umpire has been called for and Muzarabani is short.
Floated around off, kept out.
Hang on! The umpires have decided to give penalties for that deliberate effort by the fielder. And Raza will be on strike by the way. So, all that goes in vain.

DRINKS! Raza is playing a wonderful knock here and is irrating the Afghans a bit with this stubborn stand along with Muzarabani. Afghanistan wants to get rid of these two wickets as soon as they can. The Afghans are still a long way ahead and have the chance of bowling out Zimbabwe and force them to bat again. Interesting to see if they will do that.

FOUR! It has been given as a boundary. Full ball outside off, Raza squeezes it through backward point. The ball is racing towards the fence but it slows down as it nears the rope. And it stops just before the ropes as Raza takes a single. The umpires want to check if this is a boundary. Looks like that way as the fielder has gone over the ropes and then picked up the ball to throw. Looks like a deliberate attempt to make sure Raza is off strike for the next over. Going to spark some debate.

What happened there? Is that a boundary? Well, well. It is. The fielder has gone on the other side of the rope and then picked the ball to throw it to the keeper. Was that a deliberate from the fielder there? The umpire is having a word with the batters and maybe to the fielding side as well.
Fuller and around off, kept out.
The skipper is having a word with the bowler.
Full and wide outside off, driven to the right side of the cover fielder. Wanted to take a single but the fielder was quick to get around.
Good length and on middle, flicked to mid-wicket for nothing.
Sharp bouncer just around off. Raza sways away from the firing line.
Back of a length and on middle, worked to deep square leg for nothing.
The second new ball has not been taken as yet.
And all those fielders will do nothing as Muzarabani defends this flat ball around off solidly.
Three slips. One man at silly point and one at short leg.
Floated full and outside off, eased down to long on for one. Muzarabani has one ball to keep out.
Short and wide outside off, punched down to deep cover for one.
Full and around middle, hit down to long on. No single taken.
Flat and just outside off, cut to the man at point.
Loopy and outside off, poked to the cover region.
Full and around off, solidly blocked.
Fuller one this time, aimed at the stumps. Muzarabani keeps it out.
WIDE! Shirzad bangs it short again but it goes well over the batsman. Called wide.
Back of a length and on middle and leg, clipped to fine leg for one.
Another short ball outside off, this time Raza wanted the piece of it. Went for the pull but connected with thin air only.
A bumper now! It is on middle. Raza sits under it. He wasn't expecting that but did well to negotiate.
Goes for the yorker straightaway. Raza keeps it out with a flick to mid-wicket.
Here's Sayed Shirzad with the ball again. Got the 2 wickets in the 2nd session. Can he break this stand here?
No, he cannot! Muzarabani is calm and composed as he blocks this flighted ball around off.
Raza takes the single on the last ball as he nudges this short ball to deep mid-wicket. Can Rashid do something on this last ball against Blessing.
Full and wide outside off, hit to deep cover for one.

FOUR! Catch it, was the shout but it has gone to the fence. Rashid is not happy. A short ball, Raza rocks on the back foot and goes for the pull. Fails to get the timing right. The man at long on runs to his right but fails to get there. He started a bit late. He tries to field but before he can get down, the ball hits his leg and goes away to the fence.
Loopy and very full. Raza calmly blocks.
Flat and around off, punched to deep cover for nothing.
Too full from Hamza. Easily negotiated by Blessing.
Darted fuller and on middle, kept out.
Floated full and around off, played back to the bowler.
Short but too close to cut. Raza does that off the toe end. It goes to deep cover and they take one. 3 balls for Muzarabani to survive.
Flat and around off, punched to mid off for nothing.
Tossed up and outside off, driven to the man at covers for nothing.
Gets the single he wanted. A fuller ball outside off, Raza dances down the track and looks to go big over mid off. Fails to time it well and it goes to mid off and they cross.
Too full and outside off, driven firmly to long off and he says no for the run.
FOUR! Crunched! A gift from Rashid, he has given quite a few in his spell. A  full toss, Raza slams it over mid on and bags a boundary.
On middle, kept out.
Tossed up and outside off, driven down to long off. No runs taken.
Ouch! What happened there? A flat ball on middle, Raza looks to sweep but Rashis smartly bowls it just around off. Raza looks to improvise and hit it on off side. Misses to get hit on the body.
Tossed up on off, defended.
Lucky the fielder did not pick the ball up. Raza pushes it towards cover and wants one. Blessing is late in taking off but luckily for him, the fielder did not pick the ball up.
SIX! That is cracked! Raza comes down the track and gets to the pitch of it. He smashes it over the long on fence for a biggie. 80 more to avoid the follow-on.
Tossed up on middle, blocked.
Shorter and on off, Raza pushes it to mid off.
On middle, defended.

On off, defended.

Angled into the pads, it is worked towards square leg.

FOUR! Up and over! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled over the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.

This is hit through covers but no runs taken.

Edgy runs! This lands on middle and then spins away. Raza looks to defend but it goes off the outside edge down to third man for two.
On the middle pole, it is defended.
Blessing Muzarabani is in now.

OUT! ANOTHER ONE BITES THE DUST! Hamza has his third! This is angled into the pads, Tiripano looks to defend but does so outside the line. It hits the inside edge, then the pads and lobs to silly point. Jamal makes no mistake as he takes the catch. An appeal and the finger is raised. Well, well. Replays rolled in and it showed that there was no wood. Unlucky for Tiripano. Just the two wickets away from bowling Zimbabwe out now.
It is worked with the angle to mid-wicket.

FIFTY FOR RAZA! A fine knock so far. Can he keep going though? Flat ball on middle, it is clipped through square leg for one. 8th Test half ton for Raza.

OUT! TAKEN! Once again Afghanistan have taken one after the break! The wicket is Rashid Khan's but all the credit has to be given to the short leg fielder. This is on the pads, Chakabva flicks it. The fielder there gets down quickly and takes it. A superb reflex catch by Zadran there. The partnership which was going along nicely and needed to continue has been broken. Still over 100 needed to avoid the follow-on.
Quick run! On off, Raza pushes it towards cover for one.
Another one tossed up on off, blocked.
On middle, this is defended nicely.
We are back for the final session! Raza and Chakabva will hope to continue from where they left off before this session. Raza will be on strike and he will be facing Rashid Khan. Here we go...
... Day 3, Session 3 ...

The bowling from the Afghan bowlers have not been at its best once again. They have given away a few hit-me balls as well throughout the session. Rashid Khan has given over 100 runs in his 28-over spell so far. Shirzad got two while Rashid and Hamza managed 2 between them. They will now look to return and close the innings as quickly as they can. Zimbabwe would want to get past the follow-on score first. So, an interesting last session coming your way shortly.

The session started superbly for the Afghans as Shirzad got two-in-two as he removed dangerous Williams and Madhevere on consecutive deliveries. Musakanda and Raza then presented some fight but Musakanda fell. Burl lasted just 5 balls and left the side reeling. However, Raza and Chakabva did well to keep them waiting for another one as they added 52 between them.

End of a fine session for Afghanistan. They have made a good comeback after having a relatively tough first session where they could only manage 2 wickets. Here, in this one, they have got 4 and are right on top. However, these two, Raza and Chakabva have resisted nicely so far.

FOUR! Take that. No one in the deep and Chakbva hammers it on the leg side. A short ball on middle, Regis rocks back and nails the pull over mid-wicket. Hat-trick of boundaries against Rashid.
FOUR! Another boundary. Poor from Rashid. A full toss on middle, Chakabva strokes it wide of mid on and bags another boundary in the over. 200 up for Zimbabwe.

If Afghanistan manages to get past these two, they will have the chance of bundling them quickly and before they cross the follow-on score which is still a long way ahead. So, an exciting phase coming up.

We are back for the afternoon session! The Afghanistan players make their way out to the middle. Musakanda and Williams will resume their innings. Rashid Khan to begin! Here we go...
... Day 3, Session 2 ...

The Afghan bowling wasn't up to its best, to be honest. The wicket is assisting the spinners but in the first hour, the bowlers struggled to land the ball to the perfect spot. Shirzad and Hamza bowled on the pads more often than not. However, Rashid, their star bowler delivered in his 2nd over to give them the breakthrough. Another fine stand was brewing up for Zimbabwe but Hamza got the dangerous wicket of Masvaure. Now, Afghanistan will look to take a few wickets in heaps to push Zimbabwe under pressure. Join us for the second session of the day in a short while.

The session started with Masvaure and Kasuza doing an excellent job. The duo calmly went about their business and extended their stand. Both looked solid and took their chances against loose deliveries as well. Kasuza though fell to Rashid but Masvaure continued. He got to his half ton and with support from Musakanda, added another good stand. However, he fell just before Lunch. Williams survived a battling couple of overs to make sure there wasn't any other casualty.

End of a battling first session on Day 3. Zimbabwe were running away with the session but Masvaure's wicket just before the Lunch break means that both the teams would be pleased with their efforts. Credit to the Afghan bowlers for keep coming at the batters. The Zimbabwe overnight batters too did their job nicely. However, both have been dismissed.
Uppish again! Williams survives! Floated full and on middle, Williams looks to defend off the front foot but the ball spins in and takes the inner half and goes to square leg.

Missed it completely and the ball hit the leg stump behind. End of a very good knock but one might feel that the three-figure score was there for the taking.

Slips this one down the leg side. Masvaure looks to flick but misses.
Short and around off, kept out.
Quick run! Flat and on middle, nudged towards square leg for a quick single.
Full again, this one is on middle. Flicked to mid-wicket this time.
Full and outside off, played back to the bowler.
Flat and around middle, nudged on the leg side for nothing.
Full and around off, hit back to the bowler again.
On off, played back to the bowler.
Edgy! Flat and on middle, Masvaure looks to defend but gets an inside edge on the pad. The ball lobs. The short leg tries to come forward and catch but fails.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Floated full and on middle, Masvaure puts the dancing shoes on and flicks it with the spin. Beats the chase of the man at mid on and bags another boundary.
Full and around middle, kept out.

Was there some bat? Maybe not. Shortish and spinning in from outside off. Musakanda looks to work it on the leg side but misses to get hit on the pad. The ball lobs over the short leg fielder. Catch it, is the call but the fielder fails to catch. Don't think there was any bat though.
Floated full and on middle, flicked wide of mid on for an easy single.
Short and just outside off, punched to the man at covers for nothing.
Flat and outside off, blocked off the back foot.
Floated full and outside off kept out.
Big appeal again but not out again. That was a strange appeal though because the ball was nowhere near the ball. Tossed up and just outside off, lands and spins away past the willow.
Flat and around off, solid front foot defense again.
Short and spinning away. Punched to the man at covers this time.
On middle and leg, clipped towards the leg side.
Floated outside off, Musakanda defends solidly off the front foot.
Outside off, left alone.
Tossed up and outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
FOUR! Boundary to end the eventful over. Full and on middle and leg, Masvaure flicks it through mid-wicket and it goes to the fence.

In the air... safe! Floated just around off, it lands and spins away. Masvaure looks to work it on the leg side but ends up getting a soft leading edge. The ball goes uppishly but lands safely between cover and point.
Darted outside off, left alone.
Full and on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Flat and around middle, punched to mid-wicket.

Massive appeal for a catch down the leg side. Not out says the umpire. Rashid cannot believe it. Zazai was celebrating already. A fuller ball down the leg side. PRice looks to sweep but misses. The keeper moves to his right and catches it nicely. A big, big appeal but not out says the umpire. Maybe the noise was off the bat hitting the ground.
Flat and around off, kept out watchfully.
On off, played back to Hamza again.
Full and on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, Musakanda comes on the front foot to block.
Slipped down the leg side. Musakanda looks to hammer it but misses.
Full and outside off, pushed to the man at point.
On middle and leg, worked behind square on the leg side for an easy run.
Googly again but this is a good leave, a close one at it though. This one lands outside off and spins in. Musakanda covers the sticks and lets it go to the keeper.
On middle, played back to the bowler.
Flat and outside off, poked to the man at gully.

Poor from Rashid. He has been put under pressure in the last couple of overs and that can be seen with his line and length since then. This one is short and wide outside off, Masvaure crashes it through the covers and scampers for three before the ball is cahsed near the fence in the deep.
Floated around middle, blocked.
Fuller and around off, pushed to mid on for a quick run.
Flat and on middle and leg, clipped to deep square leg for one more easy run. That went off the inner half.
Around off, pushed towards point.
On the pads on a fuller length. Worked towards square leg for one more single.
Another short ball form Musakanda. He punches it wide of mid off and gets to the other end.
Flat and on middle, punched down to long on for one.
FOUR! Whippage! Musakanda does not want Rashid to get into his rhythm. Rashid ends up bowling a high full toss. A gift for Tarisai. He hits it wide of the man at deep mid-wicket to bag a boundary.
Another poor ball in this over form Rashid. It is short and outside off, Musakanda rocks back and punches it through backward point. Adds a brace to his score before the fielder can get to the ball.
Loopy and around off, kept out.

SAFE! AND HALF TON FOR MASVAURE! A fine innings so far from him. Floated full and outside off, Musakanda pokes it towards the cover region and goes for a risky run to reach the milestone. The fielder at covers is quick to pick the ball and have a shy at the non-striker's end. He socres the direct hit. The third umpire has been called. Replays show Prince has made it safely. Third half ton it is for Masvaure here. Can he turn this one into a big daddy hundred?
Direct hit! They are always dangerous. Is Masvaure short there? No, he isn't. SAFE!
Short and outside off, Musakanda punches it through the covers. The mid off fielder gives it a chase and stops. Three taken though.
Fuller and around off, Musakanda blocks it nicely.
Full and around off and middle, flicked to mid-wicket for nothing.
Tossed up and outside off, driven wide of the man at mid off for one.

Massive appeal for LBW but turned down by the umpire. Floated on middle and leg, Tarisai looks to defend but misses. The ball went straight there and hit him on the pad. An appeal, a big one but the umpire is not interested.
Flat and on middle, Masvaure flicks it through mid-wicket for an easy run.
On off, Prince defends nicely.
Loopy ball around off, kept out.
Amir Hamza is back on.
Close leave! A googly outside off from Rashid. It turns in after landing outside off. Musakanda lets it be. It goes past the off pole. Dangerous leave.
Floated on middle, Masvaure comes on the front foot and looks to defend but the ball spins, it takes the inner half and goes uppishly past the man at short leg. A single taken.
Darted on middle, worked to the man at mid-wicket.
Floated around off and middle, solidly kept out.
On middle, kept out.
Another quick run! Tossed up and outside off, dricen to mid off and they take a run. Rashid is not happy again. 100 up for Zimbabwe.
Loopy ball outside off, Masvaure dances down and looks to go big down the ground. He fails to get to the pitch and ends up getting it to the man at mid on off the inner half of the willow.
On middle and leg, Price looks to paddle it on the leg side but misses to get hit on the pad.
Loopy and just outside off, kept out.
Another quick run! A shortish ball on middle, punched to the man at mid on. The fielder is on his heels and that allows them to take the run easily.
Tossed up and outside off, driven firmly but straight to the cover fielder.

Floated on middle, Price comes down the track and plays it back to the bowler. Javed looks to throw the ball at the stumps between his legs while he picks the ball, trying to run out the non-striker. Misses and the ball goes behind and they take a run.
Quick single! Flat and just outside off, punched wide of mid off for a quick run.
Darted on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket for nothing.
Shortish and just outside off, Masvaure punches it off the back foot but straight to the man at covers.
Flat and on middle, worked on the leg side this time.
Tossed up and on middle, played back to the bowler.
On off, kept out.

DRINKS! A good hour of Test cricket. The two Zimbabwe openers were looking really solid and it looked like they will negotiate this period. However, Rashid struck to send Kasuza packing just in time for Afghanistan. So, both the teams would be pleased with their performance so far. Now that Afghanistan have got the breakthrough, they would look to strike a few more in this session. Zimbabwe, on the other hand, would look to build another partnership. Let's see who wins the session.
Misfield and runs! A fuller ball on the pads, Masvaure flicks. The mid-wicket fielder fumbles. They get three before he can chase it near the fence at deep mid-wicket.
Full and on middle, flicked to mid on.
Flat and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
On middle, tucked to mid-wicket.
Floated full and on middle, it is hit to mid on for nothing.
Down the leg side. Masvaure looks to sweep but misses to get it on the pad. An appeal but Dar suggests it is going down.
On the pads, clipped to square leg for nothing. End of a successful over from Rashid. He has taken just 7 balls on Day 3 to give them the breakthrough.
Musakanda is up and running. Full and outside off, he pokes it through backward point and takes two.
Floated outside off, kept out.
Beats the outside edge this time. Top bowling from Rashid here. Tossed up and just outside off, Musakanda looks to drive but misses as the ball spins away.
Lovely from Rashid. It is the googly from him. It lands around off and spins in sharply. Musakanda does well to keep it out.
Who is in next man in? Tarisai Muskanda it is.

OUT! TAKEN! Rashid strikes! Not really a wicket-taking delivery to be honest but Afghanistan won't mind it one bit. After showing a lot of composure, Kasuza went after a wide ball but not wholeheartedly. Short and wide outside off, Kasuza looks to run it down to the third man region. But he is in two minds. Ends up nicking it behind and Zazai takes a sharp catch. A fine knock from Kasuza but he would've loved to keep going. A very good opening over ends.
Excellent running! A ball on the pad, it is worked towards square leg. They call for a quick run and get it easily in the end.
Appeal for a catch but turned down. This was a little too full and wide too. Kasuza looks to drive but misses. An appeal but not out.
Floated outside off, solidly blocked again.
Flat and on middle, pushed to mid on for a run.
Tossed up and outside off, poked to the man at covers.
Fuller and around off, kept out.
Darted on middle and leg, keeping low. Kasuza reads it nicely and blocks.
FOUR! Take that! Rashid tosses it up and bowls it full and around middle. Kasuza slams it wide of mid on to get a boundary. Rashid is not pleased the field placement.
Floated on middle, Kasuza is solid in defense again.
Darted outside off, Kevin lets it be.
Full and just around off again. Kasuza is right behind the line t block.
A short ball just around off, tucked on the leg side.
Time for the Champ to bowl. Here's Rashid Khan. He bowled 5 overs on Day 2 but didn't get any success. His side needs one right now. Can he deliver here?
On middle, solidly blocked.

FOUR! Excellent use of the feet. These two are looking so good. Ahmadi floats it full and on middle, Masvaure comes down the track and flicks it wide of the man at mid on. The outfield does the rest as it speeds to the fence at wide long on. Prince enters into the 40s now.
Full and around middle, blocked.
Little too full and on middle, stroked to mid on for a run.
On off, played back to the bowler.
Floated around off and middle, solidly blocked.
On middle, clipped to mid-wicket. A maiden from Hamza.
Loopy ball on middle, tucked to mid-wicket for nothing.
On off, played back to the bowler.
Flat and around off, Prince is solid in defense again.
On middle, kept out.
Full and on middle, flicked to mid-wicket for nothing.
Full and on middle, Kevin defends it nicely.
Flat and just outside off, poked to the right side of the man at covers for a quick run.
Beaten this time! Floated around middle, it lands and spins away to beat the forward defense.
Full and outside off, driven firmly but the short cover fieldr knocks it to his right. Good stop.
Another one on the pads, paddled towards short fine leg. They think for the single but opt against it in the end.
On the pads again, flicked to the leg side for nothing.
And Javed too starts with a loosner. Slips the full ball down the leg side. Masvaure looks to flick but misses. Hang on, it is a no ball as Ahmadi has overstepped.
Javed Ahmadi to roll his arms now. Surprising not to see Rashid though.
Darted on middle, kept out nicely.
Loopy ball around off, blocked solidly.
Tossed up and outside off, Masvaure comes down the track and pushes it wide of the man at mid off for a run.
Floated outside off, turning in. Prince does well to defend. It kept a bit low this time.
On off, watchfully kept out.
Now Hamza bowls it down the leg side. Left alone. It landed on middle and turned down the leg side.
FOUR! Third boundary now. Poor stuff from Shirzad. He runs in and bowls a shortish ball down the leg side. Kasuza hangs back and nudges it down to the fine leg fence. 13 off the over.

FOUR! Another boundary. Shirzad is not able to get the line right. He runs in but ends up bowling on the pads of Kasuza. Kevin flicks it uppishly and there are shouts of catch but it is in the gap. Races to the fence.
Looks like Shirzad has been cautioned by the umpire for running on the pitch.
Bangs is short and keeps this one in the channel outside off. Left alone.
And another one way down the leg side. This time Kevin lets it go behind.

FOUR! Whipped! Nothing changes for Shirzad again, against the right-hander. He switches 'round the wicket but once again slips the fuller ball on the pads. Kasuza flicks it nicely through square leg. Timed it sweetly to bag another boundary.
Another ball on the pads from Shirzad. Price flicks it to deep square leg for one.
Drifts on the pads, it is flicked through square leg for two easy runs.
Flighted outside off, fullish in length. Kasuza blocks it to the man at silly point.
Quicker one on middle, Kasuza is right behind the line to block.
Flat and around off, worked on the leg side for a quick single.
On middle, kept out.
Floated full and wide outside off, Price looks to go for the drive but the ball spins away to beat his outside edge. The keeper fails to collect.
Fuller and around off, pushed to the man at covers.
Back of a length and around off, Kevin gets on top of the bounce to block.
FOUR! First boundary of the morning. A fine short from Kasuza. Once again Shirzad drifts on the pads. This one is slightly full. Kasuza flicks it through mid-wicket and bags a boundary.
Quick run! A fuller ball on middle, Prince pushes it towards the left of mid on and calls for a quick run.
Misfield and a run! On the pads on a good length, flicked to mid-wicket where the fielder fails to pick the ball to his right. A little misfield and they cross.
Good length and just outside off, kept out.
Nicely done! A short and just outside off, Masvaure rocks back and guides it past the first slip fielder. The fielder chases it down near the third man fence. Two taken.
Flat and around off, turns in after landing. Blocked.
Flatter and on middle, clipped to mid-wicket.
Floated around off, played back to the bowler.
Turning in from outside off, punched to the man at covers.
Short and just around off, punched back to the bowler.
And again. Little too wide and Kasuza leaves it alone for the keeper. Shirzad needs to get closer to the off pole and make the batter play. Don't think these two will go chasing after the wide balls.
Another one in the channel outside off, Kasuza makes another leave.
Short and wide outside off, left alone.
Fuller and just outside off, poked to backward point for nothing.
Fullish and just around off, Kasuza gets on the front foot and blocks.
Good length ball angled in from outside off, Kasuza covers his stumps and lets it go to the keeper.
Gets the line right this time and bowls it just outside off. Masvaure is right behind the line to block.
Another one spins down the leg side after landing on middle and leg. This time Masvaure leaves it alone.

A muted appeal for a catch down the leg side but the umpire is not interested. This one lands on middle and spins big on the leg side. Masvaure looks to work it on the leg side but misses. The keeper moves to his right and collects and appeals. The man from short leg does the same. Not out says the umpire.
Floated around off, Price is solid in defends.
Full and around off, Masvaure comes on the front foot and defends.
A flatter ball outside off begin, Masvaure pokes it on the off side.
Who will partner Sayed Shirzad from the other end? Amir Hamza it is.
Runs for Kasuza as well. A length ball on middle and leg, Kasuza flicks it wide of the man at mid on and scampers back for two.
Around off on a good length, Kasuza defends it towards the bowler.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Too wide for the right-hander. It is on a good length but way wide on the off side. Left alone.
First runs of the morning as Shirzad once again slips one down the leg side. Masvaure flicks it to mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Shirzad goes for the swinging ball but ends up bowling it down the leg side. Masvaure looks to flick but misses. Good take by the keeper down the leg side.

Right! It is time for the action. The two umpires make their way out to the middle. The Afghanistani players are in a huddle and skipper Afghan is sharing a few thoughts with his men. They now disperse to take their positions in the field. Prince Masvaure and Kevin Kasuza will resume their innings for Zimbabwe. Sayed Shirzad will begin with the ball. Two slips and a gully in place. Here we go...

Pitch report - Tino Mawoyo tells that the wicket has started to dry up. Says the wicket is starting to look dusty and that will cause inconsistent bounce. Feels if Zimbabwe can avoid the follow-on, they can manage to save the Test and win a rare series. Adds it still looks a very good batting surface.

Rashid Khan is in with a chat now. Starts by telling that the batters have done an amazing job in putting a big score. Adds that it is their responsibility now to show their talent and bowl out Zimbabwe. Says that on wickets like these, one needs to be accurate. Feels the wicket is keeping a bit low and they need to bowl consistently. Wants to strike early and put the pressure. Says they just have to keep it simple and bowl in good areas and that will help them get a good result.

Stuart Matsikenyeri, the Zimbabwe batting coach is having a chat. He tells that it is a huge task in front of them. Adds that they want to take it session by session. Feels the wicket isn't spinning much. Adds that coming in this series, they scored good runs in the warm-up games. Tells they are confident that they can get the job done. Says their first target for them is to avoid the follow-on and adds they are mentally ready for it.

Hello and welcome to one and all for the moving day of the Test match. Day 2 saw Afghanistan reach a massive score on the back of Shahidi's maiden double ton. Zimbabwe did really well when their openers put on an unbeaten 50-run stand in the final session of the day. The duo will now look to extend their stand. Afghanistan, on the other hand, would look to strike early in this morning session and put the opposition under pressure. Which way the game will swing on the moving day of the Test match? We will soon find out.
... Day 3, Session 1 ...

Zimbabwe had a tough day, no doubt, but the way their openers applied themselves would have given the whole dressing room some much-needed confidence. It's tough out there but not impossible to bat. Show application and temperament, and you will be good to go. The African team is staring down to a big deficit at the moment but should approach their batting session by session. That's your lot for the day. Do join us at 0930 local (0530 GMT) for all the action from Day 3. Cheers!

The day has to belong to Hashmatullah Shahidi. He became the first batsman from Afghanistan to score a double century in Test cricket and it's a moment to cherish for the entire country. After a flop show with the bat in the first Test, this is something they needed and the batting performance like this one will help them immensely. As far as this Test match is concerned, the Afghans hold all the aces and with the pitch starting to get naughty, they would hope that their bowlers do the job for them.

It's the end of the day dominated thoroughly by the batsmen! Only one wicket fell in the form of Asghar Afghan as the bowlers toiled hard on a demanding surface. The Zimbabwean openers showed good intent in their approach as they batted out 17 overs safely and avoided any casualties. Apart from a tough catch of Kevin Kasuza put down by Amir Hamza, there wasn't any other scary moment. There were a few deliveries posing issues but they successfully managed to deal with them.
Safely negotiated! Floated on the pads, Kevin works it to short leg. STUMPS ON DAY 2.
Flatter ball on the pads, Masvaure flicks it to deep square leg for a single. 50 up for Zimbabwe.
Floated on middle, worked to the leg side for a single.
Floated on off, Kasuza blocks it to point.
Loopy ball on off, Kevin prods forward and then blocks it to silly point.
Full on middle, Kevin defends it off the front foot.
'Two wickets, two wickets...in the over, get a hat-trick!' This is what Afsar Zazai is saying from behind the stumps.
Floated and full on off, Prince Masvaure stretches forward and offers a copybook defensive shot.
Flatter this time, fuller and on middle, it's clipped past short leg for a brace.
Nicely flighted, full and on off, Masvaure advances down the track and tries to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Loopy and full on off, Masvaure is on the front foot as he blocks it.
Tossed up ball on middle and off, spinning away, Kasuza leans forward and opens the face of the bat late to guide it wide of slip for one.
Appeal for a caught behind! Fuller and outside off, Kevin tries to drive but misses. Zazai collects and they appeal, nothing from the umpire.
Flatter ball on off, blocked to silly point.
Loopy ball on off, Masvaure is solid in defense.
Full on off, Prince prods forward and then defends it back to the bowler.
Flatter ball on off, Masvaure looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads. No run.
Very full ball on middle, Masvaure digs it out.
Full on off, pushed to mid off.
Tossed up ball on off, Kasuza leans forward and defends it watchfully to end the over.
EDGY! Flighted delivery landing full on middle, Masvaure closes the face of the bat early as he attempts to flick. It takes the leading edge and runs behind backward point for a run.
Strides forward to defend and does so from the inner half to short leg.
Fuller and on off, spinning in again, Prince lunges to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Flighted ball landing outside off and turning back in, Prince goes back and punches it to covers.
Walks forward to a full ball and pushes it against the spin to covers.
Almost! This was not far away from the stumps. Flatter ball on off, Kasuza looks to defend but gets an inside edge which rolls past the stumps.
Quicker ball on middle, defended to short leg.
Floated on off, Masvaure works it down to long on for a single.
BEATEN! This is superb stuff from Rashid Khan! Googly around middle, it spins away. Masvaure looks to defend but gets beaten.
Loopy ball on middle, Prince defends it out onto the pitch.
FOUR! How well has Masvaure timed that! Tossed up on middle, Masvaure drives it past the bowler and into the fence. Beautiful.
Action replay of the second delivery. Loopy ball, full and close to off, Kasuza draws forward to defend but is beaten by the away spin.
Skidding down the leg side, Kasuza tries to defend but it takes the inside edge and runs fine to the leg side for a couple.
Nicely tossed up, full and on middle, Kasuza brings his bat down in time and defends it in ahead of his front pad.
Flatter and fuller on off, skidding in, Kasuza lunges and defends.
Beaten! Beautifully tossed up ball around off, Kasuza stretches forward to defend but it spins past his bat. Zazai collects and immediately breaks the stumps but nothing doing.
Floated and full around off, Kevin gets on the front foot in defense. That's the line to operate.
Full on middle, KK defends it to mid on for a quick single.
Flatter ball on off, Kasuza pushes it back to the bowler.
Flighted ball on the pads, Kevin flicks it to the leg side.
On the pads, Prince flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
BEATEN! That ball turned a lot! Excellent stuff from Rashid! He bowls a flatter ball around off, Masvaure looks to defend but misses.
Loopy ball on off, Masvaure defends it to point.
Slows this one up in the air and delivers it on a fuller length around middle, Kevin presses forward to block it watchfully.
Sliding down the leg side, Kevin tries to flick but misses. Good take by Afsar Zazai.
This one is bowled with a round-arm action and it lands full on middle, Kasuza defends it back safely.
Floated ball, full and around off, Kevin is on the front foot as he blocks.
Lets the ball to spin back in and then nudges it wide of short leg for a single.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched off the back foot to short mid-wicket.
Floated on off, Kazusa defends it off the front foot.
Outside off, pushed to the point region.
PLAY AND A MISS! Rashid bowls a quicker ball outside off, Kasuza looks to cut but seems to have missed. Afghanistan appeal for caught behind but the umpire seems the least interested.
Flatter on the pads, Masvaure works it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Uppish but safe! Flatter ball outside off, Masvaure looks to punch it off the back foot but it takes the outside half of the bat and goes uppishly past the point fielder for a boundary.
Rashid starts with a googly on off, Kasuza punches it down to long on for a single.
Here comes Rashid Khan. He missed out on the first Test due to an injury but is back and will look to make an impact.
Spinning down the leg side, a bit on the shorter side, Masvaure moves back and tickles it to fine leg for a couple of runs.
Afghan has a word with his spinner. A man drops to long on.
Advances down the track to a full ball and once again nudges it with the spin to short mid-wicket.
Fires in a quicker one on off, turning in, Masvaure hangs on the back foot in defense.
Tossed up ball on off, Prince bends his back knee and awkwardly keeps it out on the leg side.
Loopy and full on off, Masvaure walks forward and defends it to short mid-wicket.
Uppish but safe! Floated and full on off, spinning back in sharply, Prince is forward in defense but it takes the inside edge and flies wide of short leg. They take a couple of runs.
Full on middle, Prince works it wide of mid on for a single.
FOUR LEG BYES! Poor line from Shirzad! Good length ball down the leg side, Masvaure looks to flick but it brushes his pads and it goes past the diving keeper for a boundary.
Short ball on middle, Kasuza pulls it to deep square leg and crosses over for a run.
FOUR! That's nicely guided away by Kasuza! On a length outside off, Kasuza guides it through the gully region for a boundary.
Full ball on off, Kevin defends it to mid off.
Good length ball way outside off, Kasuza shoulders arms to it.
Short and wide outside off, cut in front of point for a single.
Full and floated on off, Kevin presses forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Shortish and outside off, Kasuza allows it through to the keeper.

Huge shout for an lbw! The umpire shakes his head confidently. An arm ball around off, skidding in and beating the defensive bat of Kasuza as he leans forward. He is struck on the back leg, they appeal but nothing from the umpire. Too high, maybe!
Leans forward to a full ball and pushes it with the spin to point.
A nicely tossed up ball on middle, Prince runs down the track in a flash, is beaten in flight but does well to adjust and flick it through square leg for a run.
Amir Hamza is back on the field. Good news for Afghanistan but his right middle finger is heavily taped.
Very full ball on off, Kasuza looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Full on the pads, Masvaure flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
WIDE! Bouncer around middle, Masvaure ducks under it. Wide given!
Good length ball on off, Masvaure looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the leg side.
Fullish ball down the leg side, Masvaure looks to flick but misses.
Fullish ball on off, Kasuza drives it wide of mid off for a single.
Amir Hamza seems to have gotten hurt on his finger and is running off. He looks in some pain and that is not a good sign for Afghanistan. Let's hope that it is not a serious injury.
Short ball on middle, Kasuza pulls it hard and straight to the fielder at mid-wicket. Dropped? Seems so. The replays are not very clear but it appears that Hamza has failed to catch it.
Quicker one from Hamza, around off and the batsman is on the back foot in defense.
Loopy and full around off, Prince lunges and opens the face of his bat late to defend it softly to the off side.
Takes a step down the track to a full ball and defends it with gentle hands to short mid-wicket.
Flighted and full on off, Masvaure is on the front foot in defense.
Kevin opens his account on the 12th ball he faces. Gets forward and pushes it with an angled bat to point for one.

Full and flighted, down the leg side, Masvaure looks for the sweep shot but misses. The keeper fails to collect and the slip fielder chases it down. He slides to pull it back and the third umpire watches numerous replays before adjudging it to be a clean effort. Three taken and it's given as runs. Hmm...maybe a thin inside edge on that one!
Fullish ball outside off, Kevin watches it carefully and lets it go to the keeper.
Fullish ball on off, Kasuza pushes it to mid off.
Full ball on middle, Kasuza gets behind the line of the delivery and then defends it back to the bowler.
Full ball on off, Kasuza prods forward and then defends it to mid off.
On off, pushed to the cover region.
Sliding down leg! Good length ball on the pads, Masvaure looks to flick but it takes the inside edge and goes to the leg side for a run.
An arm ball around off, skidding back in, Kevin is on the front foot as he brings his bat down in defense.
Turning down the leg side, Prince tucks it behind square leg for a single.
That is defended solidly off the front foot.
Loopy and full around off, Masvaure is on the front foot in defense.
Jumps down the track to a full ball and defends it back to the bowler.
